adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, within the recurring-event cleanup path, the code still uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, which returns only the first calendar reference for each `updBooking`. Since this diff refactors calendar references/destination calendars to be plural (e.g., `bookingToDelete.references.filter(...)` earlier in the same function), an `updatedBooking` can have multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., collective/team member events). Using `find` means additional calendar references on that booking would not be deleted, so some member calendar events can remain after cancellation.
